realm.name: reporting-officer
realm.description: Commission reporting officer: roster import and onboarding support

realm.name: access-officer
realm.description: Decides Form K and law enforcement requests

clients.name: Directory service
clients.description: Service account the directory uses to provision users (Admin REST API) and to call notifications and the integration-gateway

clients.name: Keycloak extension
clients.description: Service account the adili-otp authenticator uses to send sign-in codes through notifications

clients.name: Declarations service
clients.description: Service account the declarations service uses to pull roster records and policy from the directory, to send reminders through notifications and to link declaration attachments in documents

clients.name: Notifications service
clients.description: Service account the notifications service uses to read a person's verified contacts from the directory

clients.name: Documents service
clients.description: Service account the documents service uses to pull a submitted declaration version's acknowledgement slip payload from declarations and a clarification letter's payload from review

clients.name: Review service
clients.description: Service account the review service uses to read submitted versions from declarations, policy and Commission references from the directory, attachments and letters from documents, and to send messages through notifications

clients.name: Access service
clients.description: Service account the access service uses to read Commissions, roster records and staff from the directory, to ask declarations for scoped disclosures and full documents, to issue packages and certified copies and check attachments with documents, and to send messages through notifications

clients.name: TSC reporting system (demo)
clients.description: Demo federated Commission: the Teachers Service Commission's own system, which files Form M through POST /v1/compliance-reports (spec 09) with client credentials

clientScopes.name: AuthnContextClassRef
clientScopes.description: AuthnContextClassRef Level of Authentiation

clientScopes.name: acr
clientScopes.description: OpenID Connect scope for add acr (authentication context class reference) to the token

clientScopes.name: address
clientScopes.description: OpenID Connect built-in scope: address

clientScopes.name: basic
clientScopes.description: OpenID Connect scope for add all basic claims to the token

clientScopes.name: email
clientScopes.description: OpenID Connect built-in scope: email

clientScopes.name: microprofile-jwt
clientScopes.description: Microprofile - JWT built-in scope

clientScopes.name: offline_access
clientScopes.description: OpenID Connect built-in scope: offline_access

clientScopes.name: organization
clientScopes.description: Additional claims about the organization a subject belongs to

clientScopes.name: phone
clientScopes.description: OpenID Connect built-in scope: phone

clientScopes.name: profile
clientScopes.description: OpenID Connect built-in scope: profile

clientScopes.name: role_list
clientScopes.description: SAML role list

clientScopes.name: roles
clientScopes.description: OpenID Connect scope for add user roles to the access token

clientScopes.name: saml_organization
clientScopes.description: Organization Membership

clientScopes.name: service_account
clientScopes.description: Specific scope for a client enabled for service accounts

clientScopes.name: web-origins
clientScopes.description: OpenID Connect scope for add allowed web origins to the access token

clientScopes.name: roster:write
clientScopes.description: Upsert a Commission's declarant roster and record exits (HR-system API clients, spec #27)

clientScopes.name: documents:internal
clientScopes.description: Service tokens for the documents service's internal API: download clean uploads acting for a tenant (spec #27)

clientScopes.name: messages
clientScopes.description: Send templated email and SMS through notifications (/internal/v1/messages)

clientScopes.name: iprs
clientScopes.description: Look people up in IPRS through the integration-gateway (/internal/v1/iprs)

clientScopes.name: directory:internal
clientScopes.description: Pull roster records, Commission references and policy from the directory (/internal/v1)

clientScopes.name: directory:person-contacts
clientScopes.description: Read a person's verified contacts from the directory (notifications only)

clientScopes.name: directory:applicants
clientScopes.description: Service tokens that may read applicants' particulars from the directory and record an access officer's verification of a passport applicant: the access service only (spec 10)

clientScopes.name: directory:law-enforcement
clientScopes.description: Service tokens that may read law-enforcement officers' accounts (names, agency, Keycloak account and state) from the directory: the access service only, which checks a law-enforcement request's provenance (spec 10)

clientScopes.name: directory:roster-national-id
clientScopes.description: Service tokens that may read a roster record's national ID from the directory: the review service only, for payroll's salary stoppage and the ICMS referral (spec 08)

clientScopes.name: declarations:internal
clientScopes.description: Service tokens for the declarations service's internal API: a submitted version's acknowledgement slip payload (spec 06), and a submitted version's document and the version before it for review (spec 07a), acting for a tenant

clientScopes.name: declarations:disclosures
clientScopes.description: Service tokens that may ask the declarations service for what an access grant discloses and for a version in full for a certified copy, decrypted for a third party: the access service only (spec 10)

clientScopes.name: review:internal
clientScopes.description: Service tokens for the review service's internal API: letter payloads the documents service renders, acting for a tenant (spec 07a)

clientScopes.name: reports:submit
clientScopes.description: A federated Commission's system submits its Form M (POST /v1/compliance-reports, spec 09)

authenticationFlows.description: Browser login: password at LoA 1, OTP at LoA 2 for step-up
Password form at LoA 1; remains valid for the SSO session
LoA 2 OTP. Step-up with acr_values=step-up re-runs only this (max age 300s)
Declarant sign-in code by SMS, or email as fallback (adili-otp)
Applicant sign-in code by SMS, or email as fallback (adili-otp)
Staff and law-enforcement TOTP (anyone who is not a declarant or applicant)
